description: Right-side layers panel for managing wireframe layers.

parameters.name: Document
parameters.description: Document whose active page's layers are listed. Mutated through undoable commands.

parameters.name: SelectedElementIds
parameters.description: Ids of the currently selected elements; enables the "Move to layer" selector when non-empty.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Disables every mutating control (add, delete, rename, visibility, lock, reorder, move to layer).

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class on the panel root.

parameters.name: ActiveLayerId
parameters.description: Id of the active layer (the one new elements are added to). When null/empty the panel shows the page's default layer as active and reports it once through ActiveLayerIdChanged after the first render.

parameters.name: ActiveLayerIdChanged
parameters.description: Raised with the new active layer id when the user picks, adds or deletes a layer, and once for the default layer after render.

parameters.name: DocumentChanged
parameters.description: Raised with the (mutated) document after every layer change.
